bull.b: Analyst notes adoption of the LIBERTY system in an office-based laboratory broadens commercial reach beyond hospitals and opens new non-hospital revenue channels.
Analyst observes that use across multiple interventional procedures and a pattern of repeat orders indicate strong clinical versatility and growing customer reliance on the LIBERTY system.
Management plans to increase manufacturing capacity and substantially reduce cost of revenue, which should support higher margins as commercial adoption expands.

bear.b: Analyst warns that slower commercial uptake driven by limited market size or penetration rates could impede revenue growth.
Analyst cautions that competitive pressures may limit market share for the LIBERTY system and constrain commercial expansion.
Analyst notes net losses exceeded estimates, highlighting near-term profitability pressure and the need for improved margins to reach breakeven.
